about.summary: A virtual data room provider for M&A, real estate and life sciences deals, based in Frankfurt.

lead: Drooms provides virtual data rooms for mergers and acquisitions, real estate and life sciences deals. Its clients are deal teams who need documents secure, searchable and ready for scrutiny. Its marketing has a similar brief: many audiences, many markets, one team of 19 keeping it coherent. Drooms runs that team from one Checkgrow workspace.

blocks.text: Data rooms are bought by people who read the fine print. Checkgrow's Competitors tracks 21 rivals for Drooms, from Box with a following of 216.6 thousand to specialist deal platforms, running 956 active ads between them as of 2 October 2026, most of them on LinkedIn.

In the last 30 days alone, Citrix ShareFile published on document workflows, DealRoom published a guide to hedge fund due diligence, and Septeo launched its first Europe-wide brand campaign. Keeping up with that, across several markets and audiences, is a full-time job on its own.

sections.label: The solution
sections.title: One workspace for a team of 19

blocks.text: Drooms runs its marketing from one shared Checkgrow workspace, with 19 people working in it. The Knowledge Center holds its positioning, products and audiences at 89% completeness, so every campaign starts from the same facts. Campaigns holds 10 campaign plans: two are live now, Drooms: Ahead of the Deal and The NPL Deal Room Report, both on LinkedIn.

Insights connects Google Analytics, so the website's funnel is visible from first visit to sign-up and purchase. Competitors watches the 21 rivals, and Social Media measures Drooms' own accounts against them.

sections.label: What Checkgrow found
sections.title: A small audience that pays close attention

blocks.text: Drooms' social following is modest for its field: 22.9 thousand on LinkedIn, 11th of the 20 rivals tracked. Its engagement rate is another matter. At 6.26%, it is 8.7 times the competitor median of 0.72%. The people who follow Drooms read what it posts.

The website tells a similar story. Direct traffic led with 30,015 users, and email with 21,996, ahead of any paid source. In a month, visitors clicked through to the data room login 20,924 times and started 12,517 forms. Social Media also scored 210 influencers for Drooms and shortlisted 8.

sections.label: The results
sections.title: More new visitors, with the whole funnel in view

blocks.text: Between 2 September and 2 October 2026, new visitors rose 31% on the previous period to 14,141, and the site recorded 81,232 page views from 29,214 users. At the bottom of the funnel, Insights counted 298 sign-ups, 134 free trials started and 219 purchases.

blocks.text: Google brought 13,654 sessions, split almost evenly between paid search and organic. The busiest day was 29 September, with 8,544 events, and Wednesdays were the busiest weekdays. All of it is visible to all 19 people in the same workspace.

statement.text: Drooms sells to people who check everything. Running its marketing from one workspace means its own team can do the same: every campaign, competitor move and funnel step is in one place, and the 19 people who need it all see the same numbers.

faq.a: Drooms is a virtual data room provider for mergers and acquisitions, real estate and life sciences transactions, based in Frankfurt.

faq.q: Which Checkgrow features does Drooms use?
faq.a: Knowledge Center, Campaigns, Insights, Competitors and Social Media, in one shared workspace used by 19 people.

faq.q: How does Drooms' social engagement compare with its competitors?
faq.a: Its engagement rate was 6.26% on 2 October 2026, 8.7 times the competitor median of 0.72%, with 22.9 thousand LinkedIn followers.

faq.q: What did the website funnel show?
faq.a: Between 2 September and 2 October 2026: 14,141 new visitors, 81,232 page views, 20,924 data room login clicks, 12,517 form starts, 298 sign-ups, 134 free trials and 219 purchases.
